hooks.name: Validate graph data on save
hooks.description: Runs the shared graph validator whenever a JSON file under data/ is saved, so contract violations are caught immediately.

action.command: if [ -f scripts/validate_graph.py ]; then python3 scripts/validate_graph.py data/mock/graph.sample.json $(ls data/modules/*.json data/graph.json 2>/dev/null | grep -v identity_matches); else echo "Graph validator not implemented yet - see .kiro/specs/shared-data-contract/tasks.md (task 4)."; fi
